integrity: The analytic proof uses the stated semigroup representation and standard Hardy coefficient estimates; no finite experiment is substituted for a proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact multicyclic multiplicity of odd powers at least three is not established.
Conclusions concern the classical analytic disk Cesàro operator on H^p; generalized Cesàro and real-variable operators are excluded.
Publication-priority search may miss equivalent formulations or inaccessible earlier sources.
title: Cyclicity threshold and even-power multiplicity for the classical Cesàro operator on Hardy spaces
